limitations: READY_TO_INVESTIGATE means metadata is sufficient to begin engineering review, not a reproduced or repaired bug.
Dependency manifests are scanned heuristically; transitive dependencies, availability of registry packages, native libraries and physical equipment are not verified.
Only explicit PR references are matched; semantically related work without links can be missed.
Runtime compatibility, contribution policy and complete reproduction steps still require engineering review.

dimensions.reason: Two connected networks make OSC unusable on the required route.
Issue was opened two days before selection.
Reporter supplied current version, OS and exact reproduction, but has not yet validated a candidate.
Success is an explicit local-interface selector used by the OSC listener.
A deterministic test injects two addresses and proves the exact bind tuple before and after repair.
Change is confined to OSC settings, construction and server restart wiring.
UI persistence and bind selection are testable offline; owner only needs a short live routing check.
Legacy configs fall back to the previously auto-selected LAN address and stale saved addresses remain selectable.
Develop was updated on the issue date and the repository has recent merged PRs.
Multi-homed show-control computers are common and OSC routing affects live operation.
Selector enumerates every current IPv4 interface and preserves unavailable configured addresses.
Fix restores OSC reception for downstream controllers on the selected production network.

ranking.deliveryNote: Readiness is an evidence-based human assessment, not a calibrated probability. Unknown inputs are never scored as facts.
